Rate how onomatopoeic your spoken Japanese is, on a scale of 1 to 5.
This app does not serve advertising or track you. The only data collected is what is needed to fix problems.

Microphone audio is used only to recognize spoken Japanese. On-device recognition is preferred when available; otherwise your device\'s speech recognition service may process it. Neither recordings nor recognized text are sent to or stored on the developer\'s servers. Recordings are not saved by this app.
Only saved evaluation history and your display language preference are stored on your device. This data is not shared with third parties.

When the app crashes or an operation fails, the following is sent so the cause can be fixed: the error and where it happened, the app version, the OS and its version, and the device model. Audio, recognized words, and saved history are never sent. Neither is anything that identifies you, such as a name, email address, or advertising ID.

You can send feedback from the form in Settings. The form is hosted on Google Forms, and what you submit is stored on Google servers. Sending is optional — nothing is submitted unless you open the form and send it.
You can delete evaluation history from Settings at any time. You can change microphone access at any time in the Android Settings app.
Microphone access is off. Turn it on in Settings to record.
